critical_findings.summary: Chicken stock is introduced at the wrong stage of the sauce and braise flow.
critical_findings.evidence: The original adds stock with tomatoes to simmer the sauce and then braises browned chicken with that completed sauce. The candidate omits stock from simmer sauce and adds it only when the sauce joins browned chicken in the braise.

rationale: The candidate otherwise preserves the sixteen ingredients, setup, parallel branches, timings, final four-way assembly, and final output. Moving stock across the sauce-to-braise dependency boundary changes a material's operation and therefore fails semantic equivalence.
